detail: Duplicate names have distinct server IDs. Opening a result navigates without taking control.
name: Find existing work

detail: Reading one completion clears its attention across clients. A delayed read cannot clear a later turn.
name: Read an older turn

detail: Reading never answers a request. Completing one of two concurrent requests leaves the other visible.
name: Two input requests

detail: Quiet Working stays Working. A reconnect stays stale until server reconciliation, even with a durable snapshot.
name: Quiet and disconnected

detail: Current state and deletion records outlive pending commands. A stale client cannot resurrect a closed identity.
name: Returning stale client

detail: Agent identity alone reports Unknown. Agent exit returns to No agent while the terminal stays running.
name: Missing activity signals

detail: The server assigns ordered report numbers. A missing report pauses application of later deltas until the gap arrives.
name: Reordered request events

detail: A late peer snapshot cannot reverse server-confirmed loss of this exact runtime. Replacement remains an explicit action.
name: Confirmed loss stays ended
